unit.title: Position, Direction and Movement
unit.blurb: Coordinates in the first quadrant, compass directions including NE, NW, SE and SW, translations, and reflecting shapes in mirror lines.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Read and plot coordinates, use compass directions and describe translations.

O2.t: Reflect 2D shapes in horizontal and vertical mirror lines.

p: **Coordinates (x, y)**: go across first, then up. (5, 2) is 5 across and 2 up from the origin (0, 0).
The 8 compass directions are N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W and NW. A **translation** slides a shape: '3 right, 2 up' adds 3 to x and 2 to y.

p: When a shape is **reflected**, each point moves to the same distance on the other side of the **mirror line**.
A reflection flips a shape: it is the same size, but faces the other way.
Count the squares to the mirror line, then the same number on the other side.
